source_title: Turnout increases for advance voting in Toronto’s 2026 municipal election
note: Citywide only; the release has no ward table. Six days of advance voting, Oct 6-11: 36,743 + 31,018 + 28,666 + 33,579 + 39,181 + 53,363 = 222,550. Liaison Strategies' same-day analysis gives about 223,000.
